# Abdul Rahman — IT & Digital Media Professional Portfolio

## Overview
This is the personal portfolio website of Abdul Rahman, an IT & Digital Media Professional specializing in building fast, SEO-ready e-commerce and business websites.

## Services Offered
- **Web Development**: Custom Next.js, React, and TypeScript builds — fast, scalable, and SEO-ready from day one.
- **E-commerce & Store Management**: End-to-end store setup, product management, checkout optimization, and ongoing store operations.
- **UI/UX & Graphic Design**: User-centered interfaces, design systems, brand identity, and digital content that converts.
- **SEO & Digital Content**: Technical SEO, content strategy, on-page optimization, and structured data for search visibility.
- **Deployment & Technical Support**: Vercel deployment, Git/GitHub workflows, domain/DNS configuration, and ongoing troubleshooting.
